status: all seasons seen-data; descriptive diagnosis, no engine/card changes or adoption test
base: pure-oreb-turnover-time-1; retain individual OREB allocation improvement

definitions.anchor: valid individual offensive rebound of missed FG; exclude FT and team rebound anchors
definitions.remainingPoints: own-team FG and ordinary FT points strictly after anchor through end of same possession, including subsequent offensive rebounds
definitions.firstAnchor: first eligible player FG OREB in each possession; one record per possession avoids counting the same scoring outcome twice
definitions.allAnchors: each eligible anchor separately; overlap intentional, never sum as team scoring contribution
definitions.specialFT: exclude whole anchored possession containing technical/flagrant/clearpath/awayfromplay/transitiontake FTs in either source
definitions.end: real: frozen normalizeRealGame possession boundaries; sim: next POSSESSION or PERIOD_END; period end zero-points retained
definitions.pointAudit: real require frozen pointsValid; exclude invalid game and list; sim assert rerun matches and full teams stats equal frozen same-seed output
definitions.defenseError: center(actual allowed points/game - predicted allowed points/game); positive = defense too strong
definitions.identity: net MSE = offense MSE + defense MSE + 2*covariance; repeat in efficiency proxy space to distinguish pace effect
definitions.interval: 20000 franchise + seed bootstrap draws; same franchise sample across four seasons, paired seed sample; equal-season pooled ratio for OREB; 95% only descriptive, no selection
definitions.acceptancePolicy: individual box-score accuracy is an independent objective; retain supported improvements absent significant team harm; no requirement for each change to improve wins
